structure: Part 15 mined all 11 traces its partition names, every one opened and read in full: hub-picker.fit.spec.js > party picker search (3: :231 Denmark search narrows and keeps the query [trace dir f-5d831], :244 no-match empty state [f-ddb58], :254 validation after no matches [f-952b8]); hub-picker.fit.spec.js > party picker details and pagination (3: :276 View details expands [f-50608], :288 later-page selection carried off-page [f-aa0ea], :311 axe [f-19512]); party-edit.fit.spec.js > edit a copied address (5: :58 pre-filled and captioned [party-edit f-a071f], :73 save [f-3d8f9], :85 postcode rule [f-967c6], :99 cancel [f-995a4], :111 axe [f-24c8a]). Both spec files were read for titles and assertions. Method: `tim distil trace -- open` refuses these zips (TraceVersionError: the trace was made by a newer Playwright than tim's viewer), so each zip, already unzipped into this part's working folder, was read straight from its 0-trace/1-trace .trace and .network files with jq: every `before` event (action list), the full DOM of each page's richest frame snapshot (rendered to text), the resource snapshots (request method, URL, status, Location, form body) and the axe `after` results. Every trace walks the same set-up (stub sign-in, start notification, origin France, commodity Felis catus, 1 animal, Overview, Roles and addresses) before its subject; that set-up belongs to other parts and is not claimed here. Pages in this slice, in journey order: (1) the Consignment addresses hub /addresses, only as the place the picker and edit page are reached from and return to (rows after a save); (2) the consignor party picker /consignors/select, always reached from the hub row's Add or Change link, in five states: first visit (page 1 of 3, 13 addresses, 5 a page), search results (2 of 2, no pagination), no matches (empty state, no table), error after no matches (error summary links to the search box), and Change with a saved off-page selection (inset text, hidden selected field); pages 2 and 3 by pagination link; (3) Edit address details /consignors/edit?return=addresses, reached only from the hub row's Edit details link once a party is chosen, in its pre-filled state and its postcode-required error state; Save changes and Cancel both return to the hub. Only the consignor role is exercised in this slice. No browser-side call to an address-book API appears in any network log: the frontend renders the book server-side.
